parsed.why: Death penalty permitted for same-sex activity, morality-law surveillance duty, documented systematic security-official pursuit of trans women with assault, flogging and detention; ICC persecution warrants. Outed trans visitor faces catastrophic state-backed harm.

Decriminalised 2004, pride events, freely registering organisations, majority-tolerance polling, protective UN posture. No trans-specific offence, targeting or documented barrier; only harm is one undated account of attacks. Open document questions, no known exposure.

Bill criminalising identifying as trans (3 years) passed and awaiting assent; existing sodomy law, documented mob justice, raided and closed LGBT centres, community in hiding. Severe hostility with thin recourse, but identity offence not yet in force.

Article 489 enforced with wide discretion and documented arrests of trans people for gender expression; police forced genital display, public handcuffing with documents posted online, outing campaign, official and religious hostility. State-tolerated targeting, operative now.

High court decriminalised consensual conduct in 2024; supportive religious authority, UN commitments. Against that: sections remain, police dismissive of victims, a homophobic killing and anti-gay-tourist activism — all dated or LGB-framed; no trans-specific exposure documented.
